comment: This class is definitely unusual and unlike anything I've ever taken before but I loved it. The entire class is 3 reacting games (basically roleplaying). The games were fun and interesting. The papers weren't too bad and grading was fair. Dr. Bezio is so funny and honest, I loved this class.

Dr. Bezio is great. The class itself was weird and the grading was confusing, but she was always available to explain or give feedback. If you participate frequently and do the homeworks, you can easily get a good grade.

Professor Bezio is an amazing teacher who makes the class entertaining. However, while it is easy to participate and get full points for many things, she is a hard grader on papers, which can impact your grade a lot overall. I would recommend this class to others, but I do recommend meeting w/ her personally before each major paper to format it.

It was a somewhat easy class, and overall I enjoyed it. It's important to participate in the class from the start, otherwise it is difficult to get full participation points. The class consisted of more 'reacting games' than lectures, which made the content interactive. If you pay attention and engage in class you will be just fine.

This class has the potential to be good, but Bezio makes it insufferable. The amount of work she assigns is completely unrealistic with a 3000-4000 word research paper, a 700-1200 word reflection paper on the research paper, and a final exam all due on the same day. She also requires participation 4/per class marking each one...Biggest regret.
great class and was pretty easy. the reacting games take some time to get used to but are pretty simple once you understand the way they work. dr. bezio is not too difficult of a grader either.
Dr. Bezio is a passionate teacher and she is very knowledgeable about the games in class. The class, however, is weird and has little purpose. It is pure fun, but not academic.

I think Bezio would be a good teacher for other classes but I would absolutely recommend anyway one else for 250.  She is a very fun and interesting teacher once you get out of the logic section. However, the amount of work she requires is actually insane

Dr Bezio is very nice and super approachable. Class was centered around role playing books which made class super engaging and interesting. Her knowledge of history pairs well with the games and she makes everything very understandable. Grading isn't always clear but she's fair and is super kind to all her students. Really unique class model.

Nice prof and has interesting lectures. But, assigns an almost unreasonable amount of homework/readings for each class. Also participation (twice a class) is a big part of your grade and it can be difficult to participate in class if you have a larger class size and because she does talk a lot, as others have said.

This was definitely the hardest Jepson prof I've had so far. Bezio gives a ton of homework, as in a research paper will be due over the weekend, but she'll still assign 2 readings, videos to watch and a discussion post. Her lectures are interesting and she can be really funny, but the amount of work in that class, whew.
a really great teacher with interesting stories - grading in class is clear and concise, and there are smaller but set pieces of homework. There is a good amount of reading, but not a ton

States her opinions as facts and doesn't show much care for students, seems as though she doesn't want them to succeed. Also seems to not understand many students want a good grade, pretends like grades don't matter then gives a B.

I regret taking this class so much. The material can be interesting, but there's so much work that it becomes a drag. She makes the participation requirement impossible, as she never stops talking. The amount of work that I have to do every night for this class is honestly disgusting. I wish she taught it different bc the class could be good.

She is super great and on top of all her assignments. There is a lot of homework but it is all clearly explained and gets really routine that halfway through seems normal. She lectures a lot but loves when you participate too! The only thing is shes super slow to get grades back so feel a little in limbo
The class is based on a load of readings. She makes class participation hard to achieve because she never stops talking. She is a smart and interesting lady, but that wasn't enough.

Not worth taking her class. She will trick you in to thinking that it is not so hard, and then at the end of the semester will make you want to jump into the lake and stay there. Also, she thinks she's funny but is really just mean. I regret taking this class more than I regret anything else in college so far.

Seems to know a bit of something about everything but not in an obnoxious way. Gives consistent, light amounts of work. Likes work to be in on-time or lose points. Topics for papers are pretty much open-ended, so you could pretty much write about anything. One of the coolest & most educated profs ever. Can get off track in discussion. Readings help

Just to be clear, if you don't know video games, do not take her FYS. However, if you do, then you will love it. Yes, there is a load of writing in this course, but while she is a tough grader, her feedback is very good. Definitely go to her office hours so she can review your drafts, helped me a lot in the end.
Hard class only way to put it

Dr. Bezio assigns an unrealistic amount of work for students. Multiple readings for each class along with a semester long paper, charity project, and 2 exams makes the class work intensive. She is a difficult grader but has a modified grading scale so students do better then they think. Overall would suggest a different and easier CT section.
Take this class only if you excel in writing papers with great grammar, she was not afraid to tell us the papers we write about 30% of our grade she expected us to fail.

Took her games fys and was confused 99% of the time. Very confusing grading system, and she is a pretty harsh grader on papers. I still don't know how our final grade was calculated, but I was pleasantly surprised. Good teacher who keeps things interesting, but I didn't like the subject.

Dr. Bezio is a very nice individual, but in taking Critical Thinking I learned very little about leadership. Readings and class discussion have nothing to do with leadership or graded work.  Even when I worked on papers for days, and went to meet with her on several occasions, I would get a B.  She is very knowledgeable, but a very hard grader.

One of the best classes I have taken, taught by one of the best professors I know. Engaging, personable, highly knowledgeable. Lots of freedom in paper topics, loves to help--lent me a book from her personal collection for my term paper! If she weren't one of my teachers, I would consider her a friend. She is a tougher grader but is simply superb.

Dr. Bezio was a great professor! She is extremely knowledgeable about a myriad of subjects and is passionate about what she teachers. The novels she chooses are interesting and the discussions and insightful. She is a hard grader on papers but I would recommend her to anyone.
